decisions.reason: Having remained in the portfolio for several years, this two-component resin injection unit sits very close to the firm's established plural-component and injection knowledge, so management is likely to keep exploiting and refining it rather than withdraw it soon.

This resin injection unit also builds directly on the firm's core fluid-handling and application capabilities, and its survival to 2022 suggests the firm has accumulated enough market and service learning to justify keeping it.

As a multi-model air-assisted airless spray gun line in a central technology field for the firm, it benefits most from the firm's existing know-how, distribution, and customer feedback loops, making withdrawal unlikely.

The data logger is somewhat less aligned with the firm's traditional mechanical strengths, but after several years on the market it likely provides useful complementary value to coating equipment and is worth retaining while the firm deepens its digital capabilities.
